faqs.question: What are recurring invoices in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Recurring invoices are automatically created based on a schedule you set, so you don't have to create the same invoice manually each time.

faqs.question: Can I create recurring bills as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. Giddh supports both recurring invoices for customers and recurring bills for suppliers.

faqs.question: What schedules can I set?
faqs.answer: You can choose daily, weekly, monthly, a specific date every month, or other custom frequencies.

faqs.question: Can I stop a recurring invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can stop, resume, or delete active recurring schedules from the Recurring Invoices section.
